Focused C22/C24/graphical and full regression evidence

design_brief.problem_statement: R7 runtime verification exposed a control-plane defect: state_builder implementation_head_sha ignored bounded C22 runtime/test/runner paths, so a post-build Reviewer PASS could target an older control commit instead of the actual runtime implementation.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main remains 4a42c2fb / registry 77. R7 is CANCELLED and must not merge. SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 blobs remain unchanged. The current harness implementation-head pathspec is hard-coded to control/harness surfaces and does not derive from the active Work Order implementation scope.
design_brief.desired_behavior: R8 derives implementation_head_sha from the active Work Order bounded implementation surfaces, excludes append-only execution evidence/control-only checkpoint metadata, explicitly includes the active transition table, proves C22 runtime paths participate in the fence, then transfers the unchanged SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 capability and completes normal H0.1 review.
alternatives_considered: Ignore the stale review target and manually assert runtime freshness
Create fresh R8 with scripts/harness declared before dispatch and repair the fence before runtime acceptance
design_brief.selected_design: Create fresh R8 from exact registry-77 main. Declare scripts/harness/** and all C22 surfaces in allowed_paths before pre-build review. After Director dispatch, update state_builder to derive implementation pathspecs from active Work Order allowed_paths while excluding execution ledger/review/evidence and checkpoint-only metadata. Add regression assertions for C22 inclusion and evidence exclusion, then transfer exact C22 blobs.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves R7 as immutable fail-closed history, keeps scope complete before dispatch, makes exact-head review cover the actual runtime implementation, and avoids schema/architecture changes.
expected_risks: Implementation pathspec accidentally includes append-only evidence and self-stales reviews
Implementation pathspec still omits a bounded C22 runtime surface
validation_plan: Validate R8 contracts/events and exact registry-77 main
Require HIGH pre-build review before any harness/runtime mutation
Repair implementation-head path discovery and assert C22 inclusion plus execution-evidence exclusion
Transfer exact SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 blobs and prove 13/13 identity
Run pinned harness unit suite and public Status/Plan/Resume including Git-only recovery
Reuse full world regression only if all production/runtime/world-runner blobs remain byte-identical to accepted evidence
Run standard/directional PC0, overlap, final Evidence Map, independent Reviewer/Verifier, then checkpoint proposal
